facts.fact: The market operator documents Atwater Market as a permanent public market.
Atwater is a year-round market near Lachine Canal with an Art Deco building dating1933.
facts.excerpt: Located in southwest Montreal, near the Lachine Canal, the Atwater Market is open summer and winter. Listed as one of Montreal's most beautiful buildings, the art-deco market has been in existence since 1933.
